This is about renaming a workspace. The policy says rename is cosmetic only, does not affect URL, API base path, identifiers; integrations continue to point to same workspace by underlying id, no reconfiguration needed. The only place old name may persist is email addresses or subdomains set up separately, not automatically updated.

Thus answer: No, renaming will not break downstream integrations; they use underlying ID. Only email addresses/subdomains may still show old name and need manual update.
